headline: Every board checked before it goes to test.

visitLine: Call and visit to your workshop
heroLede: A wiring or labelling error found during testing or on site means rework, delays and a frustrated customer. Here's what a camera check could look like at the end of your assembly bench. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every wire is terminated and every link is in place, against the drawing for that board. A loose wire is easy to miss in a full board.
labelLede: A missing breaker, the wrong rating or an untied loom are easy to miss by eye. The camera compares every board with the drawing and good examples your team supplies.
codeLede: Every board carries job and circuit labels. The system reads them and checks they match the current drawing revision, so a board built to an old revision shows up before testing.
objectLede: Offcuts, screws and cable ties can be left inside an enclosure. The camera spots anything that should not be there before the board is closed up.
